entities.name: Yitzhak Shamir
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Yitzhak Shamir was an Israeli politician who served as the seventh prime minister of Israel, serving two terms. Before the establishment of the State of Israel, Shamir was a leader of the Zionist terrorist group Lehi, also known as the Stern Gang.
